lines.zh: 我蹦蹦跳跳地跟在后面。
lines.en: I bounce along behind you.
My big mouth opens and shuts.
My stubby legs move fast.

lines.zh: 我在草地上留下一串印子。
lines.en: I leave a trail of prints on the grass.

lines.zh: 我绕着落脚的土堆转圈。
lines.en: I circle the mound where I landed.
Two steps on, I turn to find you.
I look up to find where you are.

lines.zh: 我短尾巴甩得草叶乱颤。
lines.en: My short tail sets the grass quivering.

lines.zh: 我踩到一根树枝，吓了一跳。
lines.en: I step on a twig and startle.
I trot up and squeeze in beside you.
Every few steps I look back at you.

lines.zh: 我拖着自己的肚子往前。
lines.en: I haul my round belly forward.
I sit and wait for your order.
My eyes are round and bright.

lines.zh: 我在原地打转，咬着尾巴。
lines.en: I spin in place, biting my tail.
I smell my feed.
I open my mouth and blow a little bubble.
I lie down by my anchor.
My ears flick.
I'm counting the grass blades.
I roll over and get up again.
I want to grow a bit bigger.
I shake the dust off my back.
I stare at the thing in your hand.
Still small; I only blow bubbles.
The wind smells good here.
You crouch, and I lean in.

lines.zh: 你手上的饲料味，我认得。
lines.en: I know the smell of feed on your hands.
Are we walking together?
Did you bring the ball out?

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子一伸一伸。
lines.en: I look up, neck stretching.
Pet me and I'll keep still.

lines.zh: 我的嘴很大，可我不咬你。
lines.en: My mouth is big, but I won't bite you.
Call me Gigimon and I'll come.
I run one circle around you.
Where are you taking me?
I pat your shoe.
Let's sit together.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，等你摸我的头。
lines.en: I look up, waiting for a pat.
If you go, I can't keep up.

lines.zh: 我把大嘴搁在你鞋边上。
lines.en: I rest my big mouth beside your shoe.

lines.zh: 你走了，我还能跟着你吗。
lines.en: If you go, may I still follow you?
It hurts; I roll about.
I plop down on my rump in the grass.
I blink, and my eyes go wet.
I shrink behind my anchor.
That one rolled me over.
I shake and can't quite stand.
I flatten my belly against the dirt.
You're stronger than you look.

lines.zh: 我四条短腿还能挪两步。
lines.en: My four short legs can still shift two steps.
I want to get back to my tamer.
Baby-level feed. I know it.
You've set the feed down.
One gulp and it's all in my belly.
That's my favorite.
I jump for your hand.
Just a little more.
Feed crumbs smear my whole mouth.
This will help me grow.
I push the bowl to you.
Hold it still.
I chew slowly, not wanting to swallow.
Once I'm done, I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 我被撞得滚了一圈，又爬起来。
lines.en: The bump rolls me over once; I scramble up.

lines.zh: 我撞开两步，又贴回你脚边。
lines.en: I bounce two steps off and press back to your feet.

lines.zh: 我咬着你的鞋带，被拖了一步。
lines.en: I bite your lace and get dragged a step.
Don't push; I'm this short.
We collide and I sit down hard.
You pin the tip of my tail.

lines.zh: 我从你两腿之间挤过去。
lines.en: I squeeze between your legs.
That left me on my back.
I press to your foot and stay.
I shuffle aside, still watching you.

lines.zh: 另一只从草丛里跑过来。
lines.en: Another comes running out of the grass.
Two round heads bump lightly.
My coat hasn't changed yet.
We crouch by the anchor together.
It nips my ear in play.
We roll into a heap together.
It brings me feed.
The two of us call out together.
When we grow, we can still stay together.
This meadow is enough for both.
I pick up a small thing.
I tuck it under my belly.
I carry it two steps at a run.
This thing grates on my teeth.

lines.zh: 我咬着小东西，放到你脚前。
lines.en: I carry the small thing and set it at your feet.

lines.zh: 赤赤兽的鼻子，在草里乱拱。
lines.en: Gigimon's nose roots through the grass.
That counts as mine, right?
I carry it back to my anchor.
I'll hide this one.
I spit it out. Don't want it.
Someone's near my anchor.
I lower my belly.
I open my mouth to blow a bubble.
My tamer told me to guard.
You'd better back off more.
My short legs have tensed.
I'm telling you to stop.
No moving things around here.
I give a warning first.
One more step and I go in.
I remember that step you took.
I've set my teeth.
I stand in front of my anchor.
Wherever you go, I turn with you.

lines.zh: 我的泡泡已经含在嘴里。
lines.en: My bubble is already in my mouth.
I'm watching where you go.
Nudge by nudge, a bit closer.
I know this place better. Don't wander.
I wait for you to crouch.
Short legs can still catch you.
Eyes up, I hold you without letup.
Two more steps and I'm there.
I hop once, closer.
I've stopped calling. I'm ready to move.
I bite your trouser leg.
I ram with my round body.
My strength is small.
I bite the lace and shake it, hauling.
You lift your foot and I hang on.
I spit a bubble at you.
You back off; I chase two steps.
My teeth are small, and I bite hard.
I tumble and get right back up.
Belly puffed out, I'm still cross.
I pant, belly heaving.
Care to come a little closer?

lines.zh: 草丛里钻出一个小脑袋。
lines.en: A small head pops out of the grass.
Our group appears together.
I land beside my anchor.
I lift my head and look about.
It's bright here, with plenty of grass.

lines.zh: 我甩掉背上的土，站住了。
lines.en: I shake the dirt off my back and stand.
I open my wide mouth and call at the meadow.
The moment I land I run about.

lines.zh: 这片草原上多了我们几个。
lines.en: A few of us have joined this plain.
I circle my own shadow.
I wait for someone to come.

lines.zh: 我把圆肚子搁在草上歇着。
lines.en: I rest my round belly on the grass.
Fire sears my hide and I jump.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，翻了两个滚。
lines.en: I fall from height and roll twice.
Water fills my mouth and I thrash.
The blast sends me rolling.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打在我的身上。
lines.en: Something strikes my body.
The spell glues my legs down.
I'm hungry, and my belly's flat.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我吓得不敢动。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and I freeze in fright.

lines.zh: 脚下的草没了，我直往下坠。
lines.en: The grass under me is gone; I drop straight down.
